extracted.intended_audience: readers of classic Indian folktales and creative writers studying mythic storytelling
extracted.subtask_description: A narrative excerpt from the Vikram-Betal (Vikram and the Vampire) folktale tradition — third-person mythic/legendary prose combining gothic/horror imagery, dialogue, and episodic storytelling. Useful as an exemplar of descriptive atmosphere, serialized tale-within-a-tale structure, and period translation style.
